name: aasb-aas-accessibility-inclusive-ux
description: Install the "AAS Accessibility & Inclusive UX" workflow plugin from Agentic Awesome Skills.

interface.shortDescription: Audit, test, and fix accessible product experiences across WCAG, automated scans, screen readers, contrast, and browser QA.
interface.longDescription: Audit, test, and fix accessible product experiences across WCAG, automated scans, screen readers, contrast, and browser QA. Find and fix barriers across interface states using WCAG criteria, keyboard, automated and screen-reader checks. Recommended for: Frontend teams, Product designers, QA teams. Not for: Legal accessibility certification, Automated scans as a substitute for all manual testing. Covers Accesslint Audit, Accesslint Scan, and 8 more skills.
defaultPrompt: Audit this page or component using the available browser and source. Record reproducible keyboard, focus, label, contrast and motion issues; implement the agreed fixes and retest. Distinguish automated results from screen-reader checks actually performed.
Use this plugin to create an accessibility regression plan with automated scans, screen-reader checks, and Playwright coverage.
Use this plugin to review this UI for contrast, keyboard, focus, labels, motion, and semantic HTML.

Review this project for the added coverage: Map accessibility findings to criteria and verify fixes manually and with tools; Design loading, empty, error and success states with accessible feedback. Use only the relevant skills and existing stack. Report observed checks and limitations; prepare drafts before external or production actions.
